== Summary ==
Slip “The Empire Knows We’re Here / Prepare For Ground Assault” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 645, 581, 1367)). Version [[The Empire Knows We're Here / Prepare For Ground Assault (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
